say:0:1534412001:1.text: After a long, grueling day, you finally stumble back to your quarters. The air is just right—warm, slightly humid, with a soft lamplight that practically whispers, "Come. Collapse here. You deserve it."
say:0:1534412001:1.source_cn: 渡过了充实的一天后，你回到了这间属于你的房间。温度、湿...
say:0:1534412001:1.male: After a long, grueling day, you finally stumble back to your quarters. The air is just right—warm, slightly humid, with a soft lamplight that practically whispers, "Come. Collapse here. You deserve it."
say:0:1534412001:1.female: After a long, grueling day, you finally stumble back to your quarters. The air is just right—warm, slightly humid, with a soft lamplight that practically whispers, "Come. Collapse here. You deserve it."

say:1:1534412002:1.text: The bed is a cloud, the quilt a siren calling your name. You dive in like a rock plunging into still water. If there's truly a god of dreams, that god is definitely grinning at you now.
say:1:1534412002:1.source_cn: 温暖的大床、柔软的被子，你情不自禁地躺了上去。如果真有...
say:1:1534412002:1.male: The bed is a cloud, the quilt a siren calling your name. You dive in like a rock plunging into still water. If there's truly a god of dreams, that god is definitely grinning at you now.
say:1:1534412002:1.female: The bed is a cloud, the quilt a siren calling your name. You dive in like a rock plunging into still water. If there's truly a god of dreams, that god is definitely grinning at you now.

say:2:1534412003:1.text: Come. Rest. Recharge for whatever madness comes next.
say:2:1534412003:1.source_cn: ——来吧，好好睡上一觉。养足精神才好干正事嘛。

narration:3:1534412004:1.text: Drowsiness washes over you like a gentle tide. Your eyes droop. Darkness folds you in...
narration:3:1534412004:1.male: Drowsiness washes over you like a gentle tide. Your eyes droop. Darkness folds you in...
narration:3:1534412004:1.female: Drowsiness washes over you like a gentle tide. Your eyes droop. Darkness folds you in...

narration:4:1534412005:1.text: When you wake, the fatigue is gone without a trace.
narration:4:1534412005:1.male: When you wake, the fatigue is gone without a trace.
narration:4:1534412005:1.female: When you wake, the fatigue is gone without a trace.

say:0:1534412501:0.text: There's still time to rest—perhaps you could sleep a little longer?
say:0:1534412501:0.source_cn: 休息时间还有很多……或许可以再睡一会？
say:0:1534412501:0.male: There's still time to rest—perhaps you could sleep a little longer?
say:0:1534412501:0.female: There's still time to rest—perhaps you could sleep a little longer?

say:0:1534413001:1.text: You've already had enough sleep. And yet... you crawl back under the covers. Why?
say:0:1534413001:1.source_cn: 你已经得到了充足的睡眠，但你又躺回了床上。为什么？
say:0:1534413001:1.male: You've already had enough sleep. And yet... you crawl back under the covers. Why?
say:0:1534413001:1.female: You've already had enough sleep. And yet... you crawl back under the covers. Why?

say:1:1534413002:1.text: Ah, yes. Now you remember. Your exhaustion isn't just physical—it's mental, emotional, cosmic-level tired.
say:1:1534413002:1.source_cn: ……啊，你明白了。因为你的疲惫不止是身体层面，更多的是...
say:1:1534413002:1.male: Ah, yes. Now you remember. Your exhaustion isn't just physical—it's mental, emotional, cosmic-level tired.
say:1:1534413002:1.female: Ah, yes. Now you remember. Your exhaustion isn't just physical—it's mental, emotional, cosmic-level tired.

say:2:1534413003:1.text: Time travel, Wildborn trials, battles with monsters, chasing lost memories... Enough. Just... enough.
say:2:1534413003:1.source_cn: 时空穿越、雅库伯尔……与怪物战斗、磨炼魔法技巧、寻回记...

say:3:1534413004:1.text: But no worries. If one nap isn't enough, two will do.
say:3:1534413004:1.source_cn: 但没关系，一觉不够，那就两觉。

narration:4:1534413005:1.text: You drift off again, embracing another blissful dream...
narration:4:1534413005:1.male: You drift off again, embracing another blissful dream...
narration:4:1534413005:1.female: You drift off again, embracing another blissful dream...

narration:5:1534413006:1.text: Only to wake once more, the dream gone like smoke.
narration:5:1534413006:1.male: Only to wake once more, the dream gone like smoke.
narration:5:1534413006:1.female: Only to wake once more, the dream gone like smoke.

say:0:1534413501:0.text: Why is it that the moment you lie down, getting up becomes the hardest thing in the world? No! You have things to do!
say:0:1534413501:0.source_cn: 为什么一躺到床上，就不想起来了？不行，要做的事情还有很多！
say:0:1534413501:0.male: Why is it that the moment you lie down, getting up becomes the hardest thing in the world? No! You have things to do!
say:0:1534413501:0.female: Why is it that the moment you lie down, getting up becomes the hardest thing in the world? No! You have things to do!

say:1:1534413502:0.text: ... Or maybe... does it really matter? You're a mighty mage. You've earned the right to sleep as long as you please.
say:1:1534413502:0.source_cn: 等等，真的不行吗？我可是大魔法师，应该想睡多久就睡多久才对！
say:1:1534413502:0.male: ... Or maybe... does it really matter? You're a mighty mage. You've earned the right to sleep as long as you please.
say:1:1534413502:0.female: ... Or maybe... does it really matter? You're a mighty mage. You've earned the right to sleep as long as you please.

say:0:1534414001:1.text: So back into bed you go, no excuses this time. One simple truth guides you:
say:0:1534414001:1.source_cn: 你又躺回了床上。这一次的决定不需要任何理由。你重新躺回...
say:0:1534414001:1.male: So back into bed you go, no excuses this time. One simple truth guides you:
say:0:1534414001:1.female: So back into bed you go, no excuses this time. One simple truth guides you:

say:2:1534414003:1.text: Not convinced? Fine. Some are born to strive. Others are born to nap. Eating and sleeping are universal laws, and you're just following nature.
say:2:1534414003:1.source_cn: 怎么，这个回答还不够吗？有人天生喜欢奋斗，当然也有人天...
say:2:1534414003:1.male: Not convinced? Fine. Some are born to strive. Others are born to nap. Eating and sleeping are universal laws, and you're just following nature.
say:2:1534414003:1.female: Not convinced? Fine. Some are born to strive. Others are born to nap. Eating and sleeping are universal laws, and you're just following nature.

narration:3:1534414004:1.text: At last, it all makes sense. Sleep. Sleep until the end of time...

narration:4:1534414005:1.text:
In dreams, problems melt away. In dreams, maybe even your future waits for you.
Good night, Esperia.
narration:4:1534414005:1.male:
In dreams, problems melt away. In dreams, maybe even your future waits for you.
Good night, Esperia.
narration:4:1534414005:1.female:
In dreams, problems melt away. In dreams, maybe even your future waits for you.
Good night, Esperia.

narration:5:1534414006:1.text: [Congratulations, you've unlocked the secret class: Magister of Pillows]
narration:5:1534414006:1.male: [Congratulations, you've unlocked the secret class: Magister of Pillows]
narration:5:1534414006:1.female: [Congratulations, you've unlocked the secret class: Magister of Pillows]
